message.content:
Day 1: Arrive in Kyoto and settle into your accommodation before heading to the iconic Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion) to enjoy its reflection in the pond during the golden hour.

Day 2: Start early at Fushimi Inari Taisha to hike through the thousands of vermilion torii gates before visiting the historic Arashiyama district for bamboo groves and river views.

Day 3: Explore the Nara Deer Park if you have extra time, or spend the day wandering the Gion district and visiting the serene Kiyomizu-dera temple for panoramic city views.
